conventions.cpu: Percent of one logical CPU core; summed over sampled backend and recursive descendants. First process CPU-percent sample is unprimed and may be null.
conventions.rss: Sum of process RSS; shared pages may be counted more than once. Observed peaks, not exact peaks.
conventions.mps: allocated and driver are distinct worker counters during recognize only; do not add either to RSS or to each other.
conventions.workspace: Logical file bytes in session work directories, with and without source.mp4; persistent models excluded.
conventions.sampling: External and MPS intervals are separate. Nominal interval 1 s; report actual maxima and gaps >1.5 s; no interpolation of absent samples.
conventions.time: Product monotonic clock, preparation includes worker startup, Python imports and normal weight verification/loading. Upload, cache preparation and archive excluded.
conventions.inputs: Container duration and product video-stream duration are separate. fps and first PTS are separate fields. No source-media decoding was performed by this summarizer.
conventions.comparison: Six formal runs only; profiling times excluded. One run per input; different short/long sources do not establish complexity, stability or 30-minute acceptance.
conventions.stage_accounting: Primary recognition timers are exclusive. Nested model/decode subtimings include parallel work and must not be added to primary stages.
conventions.disk_free: Volume-wide available disk space, affected by other system activity; not an application-only IO metric.
conventions.phase_sampling: A phase with zero recorded samples has null resource aggregates; no CPU/RSS peak is invented for short preparation phases.

manifest.common_implementation_identity: Frozen implementation file hashes must be compared across runs; whole tree hashes can include different report artifacts.
